newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Demirbank secures $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Turk Demirbank secures $100 mln loan.

text.p: Demirbank, a medium-sized Turkish bank, said on Tuesday it secured a $100 million loan with up to five-year maturity from international markets.
The U.S. commercial paper facility was arranged by Bank of America and guaranteed by Bayerische Vereinsbank, Demirbank general manager Selahattin Serbest said in a statement.
He said 21 other international banks participated in the loan deal, signed in London last week. The loan will be used to finance customers' foreign trade transactions, he added.
The bank secured sydication loans worth a total of $275 million in the last 12 months.
